label: External benchmark (open question B2): published pp-induced secondary antiproton source term, Table VI of di Mauro, Donato, Goudelis and Serpico, Phys. Rev. D 90 (2014) 085017, arXiv:1408.0288v3, against the profile's implementation of the same paper's closed-form parametrizations (scripts/published_benchmark.py)

source.citation: M. di Mauro, F. Donato, A. Goudelis, P. D. Serpico, A new evaluation of the antiproton production cross section for cosmic ray studies, Phys. Rev. D 90 (2014) 085017
source.read_level: full-text: arXiv v3 LaTeX source and PDF; Table VI numbers transcribed from the printed table (LaTeX tabular, cross-checked against the PDF text); no value read off a figure

inputs.definition: q_pp(T) = int_{E_th}^{oo} dsigma_pp->pbar/dE_pbar(E_p, E_pbar) n_H 4 pi Phi_p(E_p) dE_p (Eq. (1)); prompt pbar from pp only, no antineutrons, no helium
inputs.n_H_source: crpb:S02 Sec. II A: ISM composition H:He:C = 1:0.1:5e-4 cm^-3

proton_flux.form: Phi = A beta^P1 R^-P2 (interstellar, R = p c / Z e in GV), per kinetic energy per nucleon
proton_flux.source: crpb:S05 (Di Mauro, Donato, Fornengo, Lineros, Vittino, JCAP 04 (2014) 006, arXiv:1402.0321v2, Sec. 2.3, printed in the running text, not in a table); claim crpb:C09
proton_flux.use_in_table_vi: crpb:S02 Sec. II A: 'Whenever needed for illustrative purposes, we will fix Phi_p to the fit to the preliminary AMS-02 data [...] reported in' arXiv:1402.0321; that Table VI uses this flux is inferred from that sentence (the table caption does not restate it)

inputs.projectile_kinetic_energy_max_note: not stated in the paper; the profile's choice. Eq. (11) and (12) values change by < 0.2% between 1e6 and 1e7 GeV; Eq. (13) does not converge at high T (its |C9 sqrt(s)^C10| term grows with s), so its 500 and 1000 GeV values depend on this unstated limit

tolerance.rule: |q_profile / q_table - 1| <= the entry's own Table VI relative error (the paper's 1-sigma fit uncertainty of that value)
tolerance.justification: the paper states each value with this precision (Table VI '% error'); the printed values have three significant figures (rounding <= 0.4%), far below the tolerance; the paper itself calls the 1-sigma band underestimated, so the criterion is not tighter than its stated precision

documented_not_reproduced.eq11@1000: outside tolerance (+9.3% against 6.9%); cause not identified (the paper does not state its integration grid or upper limit)
documented_not_reproduced.eq13@500: depends on the unstated projectile-energy upper limit (-27% at 1e4 GeV, -8.5% at 1e7 GeV); within tolerance only by the choice of limit, so not counted
documented_not_reproduced.eq13@1000: depends on the unstated projectile-energy upper limit (-14.2% at 1e7 GeV, -21% at 1e6 GeV); outside tolerance
documented_not_reproduced.spline: an interpolation of the data, no closed form
documented_not_reproduced.tan_ng: parametrization not given in this paper
documented_not_reproduced.duperray: the paper does not state whether this column uses its Table II refit or the original parameters with D1 and D2 exchanged; no error quoted, so no tolerance
